extracted.intended_audience: aspiring stand-up comedians / students seeking instruction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for building and performing stand-up comedy routines, covering joke-writing techniques, levels of classroom instruction, crowdwork, performance opportunities, and feedback mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level 1 - How to Build a Stand-Up Comedy Routine
rubrics_metrics.description: Level 1 class titled 'How to Build a Stand-Up Comedy Routine' offered live via Zoom or in-person in Santa Monica.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended starting point: 'Start with the Level 1 class and move onto the Level 2.' Introduces routine-building fundamentals for beginners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level 2 - Writing & Performing a Show
rubrics_metrics.description: Level 2 class 'Writing & Performing a Show' with opportunities to perform over Zoom or at the Hollywood Improv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow-on course to Level 1 focused on writing longer material and preparing/performing a show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crowdwork - Ongoing Workshop
rubrics_metrics.description: Ongoing workshop focused on crowdwork, described as 'Find the Funny in Your Audience.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing practice environment emphasizing live audience interaction and improvisational material.

rubrics_metrics.name: On Demand Courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-paced online courses allowing students to 'learn at your own pace, anytime, anywhere.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flexible format for studying course content outside scheduled classes; positioned as supplemental or alternative to live classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private Sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: One-on-one private sessions with instructors (Greg Dean or Gayla Johnson) to 'hone your skills.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intensive personalized feedback and coaching intended to accelerate development beyond group classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Stand-Up Comedy
rubrics_metrics.description: A foundational module titled 'Introduction to Stand-Up Comedy.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an entry-level overview of stand-up principles and expectations for newcomers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joke Writing Made Simple
rubrics_metrics.description: A module or course titled 'Joke Writing Made Simple' focused on practical joke-writing techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaches methods to construct jokes; presented as a discrete skill-building unit.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10 Steps to Be a Working Comedian
rubrics_metrics.description: A course/module summarizing '10 Steps to Be a Working Comedian.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical career-oriented checklist or roadmap for transitioning from student to working comedian.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Be a Stand-Up Comedy MC
rubrics_metrics.description: A module titled 'How to Be a Stand-Up Comedy MC' covering hosting and emceeing skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaches structural and performance skills required to host shows and introduce other performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7 Instant Joke Writing Techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: A short lesson or techniques list '7 Instant Joke writing Techniques' for rapid joke generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actionable quick methods for developing punchlines and premises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student Showcases (At the Improv / On Zoom)
rubrics_metrics.description: Performance opportunities labeled 'Student Showcase at the Improv' and 'On Zoom' for students to present material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides real-stage/in-session performance experience; important for testing material and building stagecraft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video Reviews / Showcase Video Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Service to 'Get your Showcase Video Reviewed' — feedback on recorded performances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mechanism for receiving critique and targeted improvement suggestions when in-person feedback isn't available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weekend Workshops and Ongoings & Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Short intensive 'Weekend Workshop' offerings and recurring workshops for continued practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Condensed immersive formats to focus on specific skills or to accelerate progress in a short time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free resources: eBook, Webinar, Open Mic and Q&A
rubrics_metrics.description: Free materials and events such as 'Top Ten Stand-up Comedy Secrets' eBook, 'How to Build a Stand Up Comedy Routine' webinar, and 'Open Mic & Greg Dean Q&A'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductory and promotional resources intended to provide baseline tips, expose students to methodology, and offer community/practice opportunities.
